svg.title: Four Independent Checks Before Commercial Activation
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-four-preflight-decisions; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Independent Checks Before Commercial Activation; subtitle: An unresolved branch disables the affected activity, not the evidence record.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: These are sequential binary checks with pass and stop branches described in each detail. The US-state affiliate plan does not extend to Ontario; provincial requirements and partner permissions need their own assessment. The product adopts 21+ screening without treating it as a universal derivatives-market age statute.; caption: Non-custody, registration status, eligible destinations, and settlement economics must each be established independently.; stages: label: Activity classification; value: Pass to jurisdiction check; otherwise stop affected feature; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Under 7 U.S.C. 1a and 6d, assess CTA, IB, and FCM status using actual solicitation, compensation, personalization, and order-handling behavior. Pass only with a documented basis for the permitted scope; otherwise disable the feature until required registration or a supported exclusion is established. Never accept funds or pool user capital.; label: Jurisdiction and partner authority; value: Pass to audience check; otherwise suppress destination; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Verify DCM status and applicable event-contract availability, including 17 CFR 40.11. Separately verify the gaming operator's state license and required affiliate or vendor status with NJ DGE, PA PGCB, MI MGCB, or WV Lottery. N.J.S.A. 5:12-92 addresses casino service industry requirements; one registration does not create nationwide permission.; label: Audience and advertising controls; value: Pass to economics check; otherwise block referral; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Require the product's 21+ screen, eligible geography, current offer terms, responsible-gaming helpline disclosures, and material-connection disclosure under 16 CFR 255.5. Treat uncertain or conflicting location signals as blocked until resolved. Do not bypass partner identity, self-exclusion, age, or location controls.; label: Contract and loss exposure; value: Activate supported lane; otherwise hold acquisition spend; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Read CPA acceptance windows, seasonal caps, NGR deduction definitions, negative carryover, payment timing, and clawback rights. Require positive modeled contribution after CAC and documented adjustments; reconcile authenticated settlement events before scaling. Never redirect rejected users to unlicensed offshore or unlawful sweepstakes alternatives.

text.title: Four Independent Checks Before Commercial Activation
text.tspan: Four Independent Checks Before Commercial Activation

rect.title: label: Activity classification; value: Pass to jurisdiction check; otherwise stop affected feature; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Under 7 U.S.C. 1a and 6d, assess CTA, IB, and FCM status using actual solicitation, compensation, personalization, and order-handling behavior. Pass only with a documented basis for the permitted scope; otherwise disable the feature until required registration or a supported exclusion is established. Never accept funds or pool user capital.

text.title: Under 7 U.S.C. 1a and 6d, assess CTA, IB, and FCM status using actual solicitation, compensation, personalization, and order-handling behavior. Pass only with a documented basis for the permitted scope; otherwise disable the feature until required registration or a supported exclusion is established. Never accept funds or pool user capital.

rect.title: label: Jurisdiction and partner authority; value: Pass to audience check; otherwise suppress destination; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Verify DCM status and applicable event-contract availability, including 17 CFR 40.11. Separately verify the gaming operator's state license and required affiliate or vendor status with NJ DGE, PA PGCB, MI MGCB, or WV Lottery. N.J.S.A. 5:12-92 addresses casino service industry requirements; one registration does not create nationwide permission.

text.title: Verify DCM status and applicable event-contract availability, including 17 CFR 40.11. Separately verify the gaming operator's state license and required affiliate or vendor status with NJ DGE, PA PGCB, MI MGCB, or WV Lottery. N.J.S.A. 5:12-92 addresses casino service industry requirements; one registration does not create nationwide permission.

rect.title: label: Audience and advertising controls; value: Pass to economics check; otherwise block referral; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Require the product's 21+ screen, eligible geography, current offer terms, responsible-gaming helpline disclosures, and material-connection disclosure under 16 CFR 255.5. Treat uncertain or conflicting location signals as blocked until resolved. Do not bypass partner identity, self-exclusion, age, or location controls.

text.title: Require the product's 21+ screen, eligible geography, current offer terms, responsible-gaming helpline disclosures, and material-connection disclosure under 16 CFR 255.5. Treat uncertain or conflicting location signals as blocked until resolved. Do not bypass partner identity, self-exclusion, age, or location controls.

rect.title: label: Contract and loss exposure; value: Activate supported lane; otherwise hold acquisition spend; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Read CPA acceptance windows, seasonal caps, NGR deduction definitions, negative carryover, payment timing, and clawback rights. Require positive modeled contribution after CAC and documented adjustments; reconcile authenticated settlement events before scaling. Never redirect rejected users to unlicensed offshore or unlawful sweepstakes alternatives.
